exposure: Adverse perinatal outcome (as a predictor for persistent renal injury)
outcome: Adverse perinatal outcomes (still births, intrauterine growth retardation, neonatal deaths)
cohort: The study included 100 women diagnosed with pregnancy-related acute kidney injury (Pr-AKI) at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Stillbirths were observed in almost half of the cases with Pr-AKI and were significantly associated with persistent renal injury at 12 weeks follow-up.
mod_finding: Cesarean births were found to have a statistically significant association with persistent renal injury.
